title: Countdown Games
specs: World's biggest and most ambitious escape game 'Jurassic Island' with full size dinosaurs and giant volcano
Family friendly games with scalable difficulty and staff support
Games inspected and approved by City and fire department with safety features

includes: Game play in private escape room
Staff assistance and clues if needed
gap: Exact age minimum for players not stated
blurb: Guests play escape games where they solve puzzles, riddles, and brain teasers to escape within 1 hour. Games are family friendly and scale in difficulty with staff assistance. Some games require a minimum of 4 players, and all games are private to the booking group.
extraNote: Tickets are non-refundable but can be rescheduled · Arrive 15 minutes before scheduled game time · Games are private to your group; no strangers join
